verdict.rationale: Cognee documents a unified `.forget` deletion operation at three levels: a single data item, an entire dataset including its graph/vector data, or full cleanup of everything the current user can delete. That covers the deletion half of the story well. Retention control, such as TTLs, automatic expiry or retention policies, is not documented anywhere in the evidence. missing for 10: documented retention policies/TTL or scheduled expiry, independent or hands-on corroboration of deletion completeness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: The `.forget` operation is the unified deletion command in Cognee v1.0.
Single data item deletion: remove one data item from a dataset. Dataset deletion: remove an entire dataset and its graph/vector data. Full cleanup: remove everything the current user can delete.
Remove a data item, an entire dataset, or all memory for the current user.
